bio: The Tomio area of Nara was a hangout of the chef in his high school days. The restaurant’s name is an amalgam of the French words ‘sol’, meaning ‘soil, earth’, and ‘lier’, meaning ‘to connect’; thus ‘earth connection’. With fruits and vegetables from his home garden in hand, the chef connects his guests to the Tomio he loves through cooking. He brings dishes to guests’ tables himself, to impress on guests the appeal of his ingredients and his thoughts about them. His father-in-law helps with the gardening. The support of his family is his stalwart encouragement.
